The one decision · how a SELECTED chip reads
OURS NOW · full indigo fill
PhysicsMathematicsScience
Strong + obvious, but heavy, several selected chips flood the row with solid indigo, and it “spends” our one accent hard.
RECOMMENDED · indigo tint-fill + border
PhysicsMathematicsScience
Adapts Fresha’s fill grammar into our tint system: selected = pale-indigo fill + indigo border + indigo label. Calmer, scales to many selections, still unmistakably “on”.
